fields.summary_ko.0: Apple ($AAPL) guided December quarter gross margin to 45–46%, down from 47.9% in the September quarter, with rising memory costs and Siri AI infrastructure spending as key drivers.
fields.summary_ko.1: Fiscal Q4 revenue of $114.5 billion (+12% YoY) and EPS of $2.10 (+14%) were recorded, but CEO John Ternus noted that 'memory prices are at unprecedented levels,' and the stock declined 4% during intraday trading.
